title: Three position lighting control
goal: Make the live, traveler, switched-live, neutral, and protective-earth paths legible for a lamp controlled from three locations.

rubric.must: Three separately labelled switches S1, S2, and S3 are visible.
S2 is visibly labelled INTERMEDIATE SWITCH and drawn as a ganged double-pole changeover switch.
S1 and S3 are each visibly labelled TWO-WAY SWITCH.
Two traveler paths are visibly routed between the end switching positions through S2.
A conductor labelled SWITCHED LIVE (SL) is visible between the switching circuit and the lamp.
Separate conductors labelled NEUTRAL (N) and EARTH (PE) are visible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Conductors are colour-coded brown live, blue neutral, green/yellow earth; the intermediate switch is drawn as a ganged double-pole changeover with its crossover, with a legend for the mechanical gang link and the crossing hop.
